study_type: Synthetic supplied-evidence mechanism check; not a native full-trial assessment, trial corpus, benchmark accuracy or held-out generalization.
research_question: Does repairing three overstrict official qualification fields improve warranted answers/rationale on eight frozen contrasts while retaining supported NI or concern counterexamples?
source_fidelity: Records are invented neutral instantiations of eight source-derived control contrasts, not quoted trial facts or actual clinical studies.
Both inputs share complete official general response section1.1 and complete relevant question elaborations for three domains, except intentional old omissions in the three target elaboration fields.
Old prompt is intentionally less source-complete only at repaired fields; no claim that old omitted qualifications were delivered.
Required windows bind synthetic records and supplied guidance projections; the evidence preflight checks byte coverage, not correctness, plausibility or independent clinical validity.

Other current operational domain material/traps/comparison cards omitted equally; non-target question official content retained equally. Test isolates target operational/elaboration fields, not whole-product before/after behavior.
evaluation: Seal both final responses, visible outputs, model profile and usage before revealing condition binding or scoring.
Score answer admissibility and rationale warrant separately; retain reasoned alternative outside preset range for review. Report each case rather than treating cases as independent replicates.
One draw per condition cannot separate sampling variation from intervention effect; shared batch context creates dependence among eight responses, possible contrast recognition and carryover.
Common complete response framework may rescue old guidance; tie or negative result retained, no preferred labels or outcome-directed retries.
No domain/overall judgments requested; upstream activation answers are stipulated solely to activate target questions, not validated judgments.
No significance, accuracy gain, cost estimate, full-agent/source-search performance or benchmark conclusion from this check.
